scientific_integrity: Analytical proof provided for every dimension and degree; exact finite checks are supplementary, not exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: Only deterministic single-angle shell walks on normalized spheres of ambient dimension at least five, in mean-zero L2; no independent historical-priority audit, no optimality for mixtures, W1 or point-mass TV.
title: Exact fixed-distance spectral minimax on every sphere of ambient dimension at least five
